<\STATESEP>chapter "An Initial Kernel State"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory Init_A
imports Retype_A
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>context Arch begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>global_naming ARM_A<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  init_tcb_ptr :: word32 where
  "init_tcb_ptr = kernel_base + 0x2000"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  init_irq_node_ptr :: word32 where
  "init_irq_node_ptr = kernel_base + 0x8000"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  init_globals_frame :: word32 where
  "init_globals_frame = kernel_base + 0x5000"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  init_global_pd :: word32 where
  "init_global_pd = kernel_base + 0x60000"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  "init_arch_state \<equiv> \<lparr>
    arm_asid_table = Map.empty,
    arm_hwasid_table = Map.empty,
    arm_next_asid = 0,
    arm_asid_map = Map.empty,
    arm_global_pd = init_global_pd,
    arm_global_pts = [],
    arm_kernel_vspace = \<lambda>ref.
      if ref \<in> {kernel_base .. kernel_base + mask 20}
      then ArmVSpaceKernelWindow
      else ArmVSpaceInvalidRegion
  \<rparr>"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  [simp]:
  "global_pd \<equiv> (\<lambda>_. InvalidPDE)( ucast (kernel_base >> 20) := SectionPDE (addrFromPPtr kernel_base) {} 0 {})"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  "init_kheap \<equiv>
  (\<lambda>x. if \<exists>irq :: irq. init_irq_node_ptr + (ucast irq << cte_level_bits) = x
       then Some (CNode 0 (empty_cnode 0)) else None)
  (idle_thread_ptr \<mapsto> TCB \<lparr>
    tcb_ctable = NullCap,
    tcb_vtable = NullCap,
    tcb_reply = NullCap,
    tcb_caller = NullCap,
    tcb_ipcframe = NullCap,
    tcb_state = IdleThreadState,
    tcb_fault_handler = replicate word_bits False,
    tcb_ipc_buffer = 0,
    tcb_fault = None,
    tcb_bound_notification = None,
    tcb_mcpriority = minBound,
    tcb_arch = init_arch_tcb
  \<rparr>,
  init_globals_frame \<mapsto> ArchObj (DataPage False ARMSmallPage), \<comment> \<open>same reason as why we kept the definition of @{term init_globals_frame}\<close>
  init_global_pd \<mapsto> ArchObj (PageDirectory global_pd)
  )"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  "init_cdt \<equiv> Map.empty"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  "init_ioc \<equiv>
   \<lambda>(a,b). (\<exists>obj. init_kheap a = Some obj \<and>
                  (\<exists>cap. cap_of obj b = Some cap \<and> cap \<noteq> cap.NullCap))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  "init_A_st \<equiv> \<lparr>
    kheap = init_kheap,
    cdt = init_cdt,
    is_original_cap = init_ioc,
    cur_thread = idle_thread_ptr,
    idle_thread = idle_thread_ptr,
    machine_state = init_machine_state,
    interrupt_irq_node = \<lambda>irq. init_irq_node_ptr + (ucast irq << cte_level_bits),
    interrupt_states = \<lambda>_. Structures_A.IRQInactive,
    arch_state = init_arch_state,
    exst = ext_init
  \<rparr>"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
